culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Eitaro Tokunaga. He wanted to get revenge for a elderly lady whom Kiyomasa Kuroda hit with his car so that he could get her money. Some time later Kuroda murdered her by pushing her down the stairs leading to a train station. He had orchestrated the entire plot by forming the silver detectives, in doing so he could establish an alibi for the murder and tamper of any evidence along the way.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Eitaro Tokunaga。他想为一位老太太复仇，Kiyomasa Kuroda 开车撞了她，好骗取她的钱财。一段时间之后，Kuroda 把她推下通往火车站的楼梯，将其杀害。他组建了银色侦探团，从而策划了整个阴谋，借此为谋杀案制造不在场证明，并在过程中篡改任何证据。谋杀未遂（过去） 地点：街道
resolution.en: The culprit is Eitaro Tokunaga. He wanted to get revenge for a elderly lady whom Kiyomasa Kuroda hit with his car so that he could get her money. Some time later Kuroda murdered her by pushing her down the stairs leading to a train station. He had orchestrated the entire plot by forming the silver detectives, in doing so he could establish an alibi for the murder and tamper of any evidence along the way. Attempted Murder (Past) Location: Street

summary.en: The Detective Boys and Conan met a group called the Silver Detective League, who are similar to them. The Silver Detective League said that they saw a thief with blond hair and followed him into a house, where they saw Kiyomasa Kuroda's corpse.
